status.description:
The status of the image.

- `draft` - the project was created but has not been submitted for rendering
- `queued` - the job is waiting for an available server
- `rendering` - the job is being processed; the `image.started` webhook event fires when rendering begins
- `complete` - the job finished successfully; fires `image.completed`
- `error` - the job failed during processing; fires `image.errored`
- `canceled` - the job was manually canceled (for example from the Magic Hour web app)

**Note:** `rendering`, `complete`, and `error` have matching webhook events; `canceled` does not - a canceled job emits no webhook event, so poll this endpoint to detect cancellation.

n_4764ad6fc40be637.name: Read the project ID
n_4764ad6fc40be637.source: export default function created({body}){if(!body||typeof body.id!=='string'||!body.id)throw Error('Missing project ID');return{id:body.id}}

n_d3d6d753d1b2777d.name: Check image status
n_d3d6d753d1b2777d.source: export default function status({body,projectId,previous}){const {id,status,downloads}=body??{};if(id!==projectId)throw Error('Project ID mismatch');const count=previous==null?1:previous.count+1;if(!Number.isInteger(count)||count>60)throw Error('Polling timed out for project '+projectId);if(status==='error'||status==='canceled')throw Error('Generation '+status+' for project '+projectId);if(status==='complete'){if(!Array.isArray(downloads)||!downloads[0]||typeof downloads[0].url!=='string')throw Error('Missing download for project '+projectId);return{state:{count},done:true,url:downloads[0].url}}if(!['draft','queued','rendering'].includes(status))throw Error('Unexpected status for project '+projectId);if(count===60)throw Error('Polling timed out for project '+projectId);return{state:{count},done:false,url:''}}

n_7f69e3450b2ec8eb.name: Download the image
n_7f69e3450b2ec8eb.source:
import{Buffer}from'node:buffer';
export default async function download({url,id},context){if(typeof url!=='string'||!/^https:\/\//.test(url))throw Error('Invalid image URL for project '+id);const r=await context.fetch(url,{method:'GET'});if(!r.ok)throw Error('Download failed for project '+id);const b=Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()),png=b.length>8&&b.subarray(0,8).equals(Buffer.from([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10])),jpeg=b.length>3&&b[0]===255&&b[1]===216&&b[2]===255;if(!png&&!jpeg)throw Error('Invalid image for project '+id);const mediaType=png?'image/png':'image/jpeg',image=await context.artifact.put(b,{name:png?'image.png':'image.jpg',mediaType});return{image,url,id}}
